title: Three real Python prompt arguments
declared_scope: Read-only local Python invocations used to validate authentic process capture.

steps.prompt: Count the words in this exact first prompt.
args: import hashlib,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; print('REAL CPYTHON PROCESS'); print('EXECUTABLE=' + sys.executable); print('PROMPT=' + p); print('WORDS=' + str(len(p.split()))); print('SHA256=' + hashlib.sha256(p.encode()).hexdigest())
